State.description: The tenant state. Usually set in a section named after a tenant, e.g. 'OrchardCore:MyTenant:State'; any section under 'OrchardCore' that defines a valid 'State' is loaded as a tenant, which allows pre-configuring a tenant with the 'Uninitialized' state before it is set up. Tenant settings defined directly under 'OrchardCore' apply to all tenants. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Configuration/.

RequestUrlHost.description: The host name(s) the tenant responds to. Multiple hosts can be separated with a comma or a space. Can also be set in a section named after a tenant, e.g. 'OrchardCore:MyTenant:RequestUrlHost'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Configuration/.

RequestUrlPrefix.description: The URL path prefix the tenant responds to, e.g. 'mytenant'. Can also be set in a section named after a tenant, e.g. 'OrchardCore:MyTenant:RequestUrlPrefix'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Configuration/.

DatabaseProvider.description: The database provider of the tenant: 'Sqlite', 'SqlConnection' (SQL Server), 'MySql' or 'Postgres'. Define it with 'ConnectionString' directly under 'OrchardCore' to share the same database configuration between all tenants. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

ConnectionString.description: The database connection string of the tenant. Not used by the 'Sqlite' provider. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

TablePrefix.description: The prefix of the tenant database tables, allowing several tenants to share the same database. Not used by the 'Sqlite' provider. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

Schema.description: The database schema of the tenant tables. Not used by the 'Sqlite' provider. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

DatabaseName.description: The file name of the tenant SQLite database, stored in the tenant folder. Setup uses 'OrchardCore.db' when not provided. Only used by the 'Sqlite' provider. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

RecipeName.description: The name of the recipe preselected when the tenant is set up.

Features.description: The identifiers of features that are always enabled for the tenant and can't be disabled.

ShellActivateLockTimeout.description: The timeout in milliseconds to acquire a distributed lock before activating a tenant. Only used when the distributed lock implementation is not a local lock, e.g. when the Redis Lock feature is enabled.

ShellActivateLockExpiration.description: The expiration in milliseconds of the distributed lock acquired before activating a tenant. Only used when the distributed lock implementation is not a local lock.

ShellRemovingLockTimeout.description: The timeout in milliseconds to acquire a distributed lock before removing a tenant. A low value is recommended because only one instance is intended to remove a given tenant. Only used when the distributed lock implementation is not a local lock.

ShellRemovingLockExpiration.description: The expiration in milliseconds of the distributed lock acquired before removing a tenant. Only used when the distributed lock implementation is not a local lock.

BackgroundService.description: Configures the host service that runs the background tasks of all tenants. Read from the application configuration only, not per tenant.

ShellWarmup.description: Whether all tenants are loaded when the application starts so that their background tasks run without waiting for a first request. By default, background tasks wait for their tenant to be lazily built on a first matching request.

PollingTime.description: The time to wait between two executions of all the background tasks of a given tenant, in the 'hh:mm:ss' format.

MinimumIdleTime.description: The minimum idle time before the background tasks of a tenant are triggered, as well as between tasks, in the 'hh:mm:ss' format.

IgnoreSystemSettings.description: Whether to ignore the culture settings of the operating system user (e.g. custom date or number formats) so that the current culture doesn't depend on the local computer settings.

TempDirectory.description: Configures where temporary files, such as in-progress chunked or resumable uploads and extracted import archives, are stored. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/core/temporary-file-storage/.

Path.description: The base path under which tenant-scoped temporary files are stored. When not set, the operating system temporary directory is used. Point it to a larger or shared volume, such as a mounted Azure Files or AWS EFS/FSx share.

StaticFileOptions.description: Configures the static files served from the modules and themes. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Modules/.

CacheControl.description: The 'Cache-Control' header sent with the static files served from the modules and themes.

OrchardCore_BackgroundService.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_BackgroundService' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:BackgroundService' instead.

OrchardCore_Localization_CultureOptions.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Localization_CultureOptions' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Localization:CultureOptions' instead.
